headline: With tax receipts flat, budget hurdles remain for WA leaders
summary: Washington's latest tax forecast shows a $22 million increase for the current budget and $430 million more for the next biennium. However, this does not eliminate projected deficits of several hundred million dollars in 2028 and a multibillion-dollar shortfall in the following budget. Lawmakers acknowledge revenue is up but far from enough to balance the budget, setting up the third consecutive year of budget shortfalls. The new high-earner income tax is predicted to generate hundreds of millions more than previously thought, but its future is uncertain due to legal challenges and an initiative on the ballot.

headline: Missouri should take the time to get its next education commissioner right
summary: Missouri's State Board of Education is seeking a new Commissioner of Education, who will guide the state through significant changes in education policy, including a new A-F school grading system, potential school funding reforms, and improving student literacy. Interim Commissioner Stacey Preis is maintaining stability while the board conducts a thoughtful search for a permanent leader who understands policy implementation and can navigate diverse stakeholder interests.

headline: Community members protest ICE after Bismarck-area detainments increase
summary: About 75 protesters gathered in Bismarck to denounce ICE operations that led to the temporary closure of a local Mexican restaurant after two employees were arrested, despite having authorization to work. Protesters argue that ICE is overstepping and not following proper procedures, potentially impacting public trust in immigration enforcement.

headline: Blumenthal forum on ICE shootings, AI risks: CT politics news
summary: U.S. Sen. Richard Blumenthal hosted a forum focused on deadly shootings involving federal immigration agents, with testimony from families of victims, including Renée Good, a citizen killed by an ICE agent in Minneapolis. Blumenthal criticized the Department of Homeland Security for not changing its practices despite previous promises.

headline: At least 10 people detained at Columbus County checkpoint, NC advocacy group says
summary: Several hundred protested ICE and Border Patrol raids in North Carolina. A checkpoint in Tabor City resulted in at least 10 arrests, mostly Latino immigrants, with detainees' locations still unknown. Sheriff's office involved in federal immigration enforcement.
